_note: 學習路徑內容建置第4批 #5／6：must vs have to（eng.t_adv.modal.must-vs-haveto，學測級／高階）。must 與 have to 都表義務（has to 配第三人稱單數）；關鍵對比 mustn't（禁止、不可以）≠ don't have to（不必、沒必要）。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix mh_）。

units.title_zh: must 與 have to（含 mustn't／don't have to 的差別）
units.can_do: 我能用 must／have to 表示「必須、有義務」（第三人稱單數用 has to），並分辨 mustn't（禁止、不可以）和 don't have to（不必、沒必要）這兩個意思完全不同的否定。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'must' and 'have to' both express strong obligation or necessity — something it is necessary to do: I must finish this today. We have to wear a seatbelt. 'must' is a modal and takes the base verb; 'have to' uses 'has to' for he/she/it.
claims.verification_ref: must／have to 表義務，has to 配第三人稱單數；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'mustn't' (must not) means it is forbidden — you are not allowed to do it: You mustn't touch that; it's dangerous. You mustn't park here.
claims.verification_ref: mustn't＝禁止/不准；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'don't/doesn't have to' means there is no obligation — it is not necessary, but you may if you want: It's Sunday, so you don't have to get up early.
claims.verification_ref: don't have to＝不必/沒必要（可做可不做）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'mustn't' and 'don't have to' are very different: 'mustn't' = it is forbidden; 'don't have to' = it is not necessary. You mustn't park here (not allowed) vs The museum is free, so you don't have to buy a ticket (not necessary).
claims.verification_ref: mustn't（禁止）vs don't have to（沒必要）對比；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: must 和 have to 都表示「必須、有義務」——一定要做的事。must 是情態助動詞，後面接原形；have to 在第三人稱單數（he／she／it）要用 has to。
I must finish my homework today. She has to wear a uniform to school.　（我今天一定要寫完功課。她上學必須穿制服。表義務。）
但否定意思差很多！mustn't（＝must not）是「禁止、不可以」——不准做。
You mustn't touch that wire; it's dangerous.　（你不可以碰那條電線，很危險。mustn't＝禁止。）
don't have to（第三人稱 doesn't have to）是「不必、沒有必要」——不做也沒關係，想做可以。千萬別把 mustn't 和 don't have to 搞混。
It's Sunday. You don't have to get up early.　（今天星期天，你不必早起。don't have to＝沒必要。）

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：It's a rule. Everyone ____ wear a seatbelt in the car.（這是規定，每個人在車上都必須繫安全帶。表義務）

distractor_rationales.must to: must 後面直接接原形，沒有 to；應是 must wear。
distractor_rationales.mustn't: mustn't 是「不可以繫安全帶」，意思相反；規定是必須繫。

practice.feedback: 表「必須」用 must + 原形：Everyone must wear a seatbelt。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：My school is strict. Every student ____ wear a uniform.（我的學校很嚴格，每個學生都必須穿制服。第三人稱單數）

distractor_rationales.have to: Every student 是單數，要用 has to，不是 have to。
distractor_rationales.must to: must 後面直接接原形，沒有 to；此處空格要填 has to。
distractor_rationales.has: 少了 to；have／has 表義務要用 has to。

practice.feedback: 第三人稱單數表義務用 has to：Every student has to wear a uniform。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：That machine is dangerous. You ____ touch it.（那台機器很危險，你不可以碰它。禁止）

distractor_rationales.don't have to: don't have to touch 是「不必碰」；但機器危險是「不准碰」，要用 mustn't。
distractor_rationales.have to: have to touch 是「必須碰」，意思相反。
distractor_rationales.must: must touch 是「必須碰」，意思相反；危險是不准碰。

practice.feedback: 表「禁止、不准」用 mustn't：You mustn't touch it。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：Tomorrow is a holiday, so we ____ go to school.（明天放假，所以我們不必上學。沒必要）

distractor_rationales.mustn't: mustn't go 是「不准上學」；放假只是「不必」上學，不是禁止，要用 don't have to。
distractor_rationales.have to: have to go 是「必須上學」，意思相反。
distractor_rationales.must: must go 是「必須上學」，意思相反。

practice.feedback: 表「不必、沒必要」用 don't have to：we don't have to go to school。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：This is a library. You ____ make a lot of noise.（這是圖書館，你不可以大聲吵鬧。禁止）

distractor_rationales.don't have to: don't have to make noise 是「不必吵鬧」，但圖書館是「不准」吵鬧，要用 mustn't。
distractor_rationales.have to: have to make noise 是「必須吵鬧」，意思相反。
distractor_rationales.must: must make noise 是「必須吵鬧」，意思相反。

practice.feedback: 表「不准」用 mustn't：You mustn't make a lot of noise in a library。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: You don't have to finish it today, but you mustn't forget it.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：don't have to（不必）和 mustn't（不可以）有沒有分清楚，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。mustn't 的 t 不發音、唸成 /ˈmʌsnt/；警告句語氣稍重，句尾下收。

lines.text: You mustn't touch that; it's dangerous.
lines.intonation: mustn't 稍重、警告語氣、句尾下收

lines.text: You don't have to come if you're busy.
lines.intonation: 平穩、輕鬆語氣、句尾下收
